lines.text: Okay, I think we're all here. Can we sort out Saturday quickly?
Yeah, go.
So the market opens at eight, and we need to be set up before then.
Hmm. Did they say we can drive in from seven, or half seven?
Seven. It was in the email from last week.
Right, seven. Thanks.
And someone needs to pick up the float from the other place before that.
Oh, and the gazebo. We're still borrowing the green one, aren't we?
I think so. Or was it the blue one this time? I can't remember who said.
Whichever one doesn't have the bent leg, honestly.
Ha, fair.
We said we'd return it by Monday, so that's fine either way.
Monday, or Sunday evening? I thought they needed it Sunday.
Anyway, did you see the jar that fell off the table last week?
The one that rolled under the cheese van? Yes.
It didn't even break. I want that jar on the poster.
We are not putting a jar on the poster.
Oh, before I forget. The card reader battery is nearly dead.
Is the charger in the cash box?
No, I checked. I'll grab a new one on the way, it's cheap.
Okay. So Saturday at seven, and we'll sort the rest on the day?
Sounds good. See you both then.
